billPhoto.title: Photo of a bill or challan
billPhoto.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds companies on Admin → Companies.
billPhoto.noRight: You don't have the right to send supplier bills. Ask Admin.
billPhoto.readOnly: Read-only access: bills can be seen but not sent.
billPhoto.take: Take a photo of the bill
billPhoto.frameNote: Whole bill inside the frame · flat · good light
billPhoto.offline: No network. Send the photo when you are back online.
billPhoto.uploadFailed: Could not upload the photo. Nothing was saved; try again.
billPhoto.done: Sent. The bill waits on Bill photo capture to be checked and matched.
billPhoto.footnote: Photos go to a private store in India, kept with the bill. Reading the photo automatically arrives once the AI provider is chosen.
